changelog:
Initial release of bidding-hunter — an automated government procurement bid discovery engine.

- Scans Chinese procurement platforms for bids matching user-configured keywords.
- Tracks bid statuses, deadlines, and sends reminders through deadline-aware reports.
- Users can add or customize target platforms using built-in adapters and an extensible plugin model.
- All operations performed via the `bidding-hunter` CLI and standard tools; strict tool-discipline enforced.
- Platform-agnostic; no ad-hoc scripts or browser automation outside defined adapters.
- Detailed documentation and workflow for adding new platforms and tracking opportunities.
summary: Automated government procurement bid discovery engine. Scans multiple Chinese procurement platforms, matches configurable keywords, tracks bid statuses, and delivers deadline-aware reports. Users configure their own keywords and monitoring targets; built-in adapters cover 5 major platforms with an extensible plugin model for adding more.
